mechanism: Phenelzine (MAOI) combined with mefloquine (which has SEROTONERGIC and CNS-stimulant properties) creates risk of serotonin syndrome, hypertensive crisis, and severe CNS toxicity; mefloquine also carries independent neurotoxicity risks that are potentiated by MAOI.
action: Avoid this combination absolutely; if mefloquine is necessary for malaria prophylaxis/treatment, discontinue phenelzine at least 14 days prior and consider alternative antimalarials (atovaquone-proguanil, artemether-lumefantrine); do not restart phenelzine until at least 2 weeks after mefloquine completion due to mefloquine's long half-life.
